# Envelope

*SMA with fixed percentage bands.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Envelope** under **Bands & channels**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `20` |
| Percent | float | `10` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Basis color | color | `"#FF6D00"` |
| Upper color | color | `"#2962FF"` |
| Lower color | color | `"#2962FF"` |
| Background | color | `"rgba(33,150,243,0.05)"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/envelope.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Envelope", shortTitle: "Env", overlay: true });
const length = input.int("Length", 20, { min: 1 });
const percent = input.float("Percent", 10, { step: 0.5 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const basis = ta.sma(src, length);
const upper = ta.calc([basis], (b) => b * (1 + percent / 100)), lower = ta.calc([basis], (b) => b * (1 - percent / 100));
plot(basis, { title: "Basis", color: input.color("Basis color", "#FF6D00", { group: "Style" }) });
plot(upper, { title: "Upper", color: input.color("Upper color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
plot(lower, { title: "Lower", color: input.color("Lower color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
fill(upper, lower, { title: "Background", color: input.color("Background", "rgba(33,150,243,0.05)", { group: "Style" }) });
```
